header_sentences: See Internal, and see Babel, Chaldea, Gog, Israelite, and Jew.

contexts.text: So long as these external things are not mastered...
The external of the Church is a something inanimate, but it lives from the internal...
See Canaan (Ham's son).
See Japheth.
External bonds. (See Bind.)
Under Nimrod, see this reference.
These are the externals which are removed in the other life.
That there would he only an external in the Lord's Kingdom. Signified.
What is doctrinal itself does not make the external (of the Church)... but it is life according to doctrinal things.
That there should not be an external of the Church. Signified.
That the external should not be the heir of His kingdom. Signified. The external is indeed the heir, but only through the internal, because they then act as one. (Explained.)
From externals sees internals. AC 1807.
From the mother he receives all that is external. AC 2005. AC 3128.
That they saw only the externals of the Church represented in natural things. Signified.
This external symbol is commanded because the greatest part of mankind are in external worship; and therefore without some external, there would be scarcely anything holy with them.
Remain merely in the externals (of the Word.)
Such an external is born with some... but is afterwards subjugated, yet remains in the external.
See Lot (the man).
They who are in such good care only for external things...
As this Rational was born... by an external way, which is that of sensuous things...
They did not worship external things; but by means of external things remembered internal ones...
Vessels = the externals of spiritual things.
That only external or natural things were to be purified. Signified.
Jacob = those who were in the externals of that Church.
With that nation... the mere external holiness served as a plane...
(But) Christians... cannot be in a holy external separated from an internal.
As skins = external things... and as it is external things which cover internal ones, or natural things which cover spiritual and celestial ones...
The Divine things which are in external ones. Representation.
How truth can be conjoined with good, and this... from such things as are external...
What is external is relatively general... AC 4345.
External affections. Signified, Explained.
External things are further from the Divine... and are therefore relatively inordinate...
Spiritual conception and birth from external to internal. Signified. AC 3868. AC 3870. AC 3874.
These externals... are taken away in the other life... because external things are put off together with the body; and external things are of no further use.
This evil... does indeed remain, but adheres only in externals...
They were only in externals...
The Holy Supper is an external of the Church which contains an internal...
Still, the external things in which they were kept could serve as a plane...
When these external things are put off... internal things appear.
Such are all who are only in external things. Described. AC 4464.
They who belonged to the Most Ancient Church did not care for these external things... AC 54.
Accession to external things. Signified.
Progress from what is external to more interior things. Signified.
The external of the Jewish religion was for the most part like the external of the Ancient Church...
Those in the Christian Church who are in what is external without what is internal...
Idolatry is... also to worship external things without internal ones.
The Jews are in the lowest of external things.
From the external alone no one can see whether it is falsity or truth.
That the external (of the Jewish nation) was of such a character. Signified.
In the external form.
After death, a man is first kept in externals... but afterwards externals are taken away from him...
External things occupy the whole attention...
To call Elisha bald = that the Word is as it were devoid of an external.
Our world is in external things... AC 8031. HH 309.
They who are in externals without an internal... AC 5998:end. AC 9377:end.
When man is in external things, as when he is in worldly and corporeal things, the Angels are removed.
It is from this progression... that the external is said to be the father of the internal.
Their externals alone are in light.
Thus (the Pharisee) accounted external things as the veriest truths.
He is there not such as he had appeared in externals; for externals are taken away from him... AC 6667:end. AC 7032:3. AC 8870:3.
Under Church, see these references. AC 6775.
His bones = that which is in the highest degree external, or the ultimate of the Church.
Hence it is that man... became external, and this successively. AC 6631.
The Israelites were entirely in external things. AC 6832. AC 6941. AC 6997:3.
Scales (of a fish) = things which are plainly external, thus sensuous things...
They who are in externals without an internal... cannot be enlightened, thus cannot be confirmed in truths...
When the external is put off... AC 8455:2.
(Why external things must be taken away in the other life, although they enable them to act well.)
By this the external is initiated into the internal of charity...
When an Angel or Spirit is in external things, he is in shade...
No conjunction with an external devoid of an internal. Signified.
The worship of what is external. Signified, Explained.
As in the Christian world at this day they are... in externals devoid of an internal...

As takes place with those who are solely in externals and not at the same time in internals, that is, with those who are in the loves of self and of the world, and not in love to the Lord and towards the neighbour.
That Divine truth is hurtful to those who are in externals devoid of an internal. Signified.
All external things hold internal ones together. Signified.
Under Curtain, see this reference.
Under Ephod, see this reference.

The reason that which is most external is more holy than internal things, is that the external holds together all the interior things in their order, form, and connection; so that if the external were removed the interior things would be dissipated; for there internal things not only cease, but are together. Explained.
The external of the Spiritual Kingdom. AC 9834.
The external of the Celestial Kingdom.
The foundations = the external things there.
Polish = what is external.
To remove external things in order that internal ones may appear. Signified, Explained.
The state of the externals which proceed from Divine truth in the Spiritual Kingdom. Signified.
The linen breeches = the external of marriage love.
The external itself is truth, (because) internals cease in externals, and rest on them as their supports, and supports are truths.

A holy external devoid of an internal penetrates no further than to the first threshold of Heaven, and is there dissipated; but a holy external from an internal penetrates right into Heaven, according to the quality of the internal; thus it penetrates to the Lord...
They who are in Hell are in externals and not in internals...
That that people was entirely in externals devoid of any internal, is signified by the golden calf... AC 10397. AC 10407.
All those are in externals devoid of an internal who are in the loves of self and of the world. Explained.

They who are in externals devoid of an internal communicate with the Hells, and not with the Heavens; for the internal of man is his Heaven, and his external is his world... And when the internal is closed, the external is no longer ruled from Heaven, but from Hell.
They who are in externals devoid of an internal want to be worshipped as a god...
They who are in externals separated from an internal all turn themselves away from what is Divine... Signified, Explained. AC 10422. AC 10429. AC 10533, Explained.
What is meant by being in externals devoid of an internal. Explained. AC 10472.
The Egyptians = those who are in mere externals. Explained.
The reason they who are in externals separated from an internal have no power to resist the evils and falsities which are from Hell. Signified, Explained.
All who are in Hell are in externals separated from what is internal, because they are in the loves of self and of the world...
Those who are in externals from what is internal. Signified.
What is external separated from what is internal is Hell with man.
Lest what is true and good from Heaven should enter into the external when the internal is closed. Signified.
When what is internal is completely closed, the internal of the Church... is neither denied nor acknowledged... and then a holy external can exist...

They who are in externals separated from what is internal cannot receive anything from Heaven; for it is the internal which receives thence, and the external devoid of it receives from no other source than Hell.
The quality of their external, that it is devoid of what is Divine. Signified.
Whether you say the external of worship and of the Church, or Hell, it is the same. Explained.
The external of worship, of the Church, and of the Word, in which are internal things. Signified.

All who are in externals devoid of what is internal, if they reverence, adore, and as it were love God... do so for the sake of themselves... and if they do not obtain what they desire, they desert God. Signified.
That what is Divine must be in the external of the Church, of worship, and of the Word. Signified.
The external which Moses represents is an external not so separated from what is internal, as is the external in which is the nation itself...
Everything Divine of Heaven and the Church upon what is external separated from what is internal. Signified.
What is obscure and false of faith such as exists with those who are in externals devoid of what is internal. Signified.
That the externals of the Word, of the Church, and of worship will be seen, but not the internals. Signified.

The external which encompasses man in the world is accommodated to uses in the world; it is this external which is rejected when the man dies: whereas the external which is accommodated to uses in the other life does not die. This external, together with the internal, is called the spirit...

To be in externals and not in what is internal is to worship external things as holy, without any acknowledgement of the Lord, and without love to God for the sake of God, but for the sake of self... But as they could be in a holy external for the sake of themselves, and this could be marvellously converted into a holy external for the sake of God by means of the Spirits who were with them... that nation was received.
The external of the Word, of the Church, and of worship, such as it was for the sake of that nation. Signified, Explained.
Moses represents the external of the Church, of worship, and of the Word which receives Divine truth.
But the external which did not receive the internal was with the Israelitish nation. AC 10608, Signified.
Mount Horeb = the external of the Church, of worship, and of the Word.
What is the external which receives the internal, and what is the external which does not receive it. Explained.
Reception from influx into what is external. Signified.
Because such an external (as was represented by Moses) was received. Signified.
Then in what is external there is a Divine internal. Signified.
The apperception of those who are in the externals of the Church, of worship, and of the Word devoid of internal things. Signified.

They who are only in the externals of worship and of the Word... cannot endure interior things; because they... are in the love of self and of the world, and hence in a lumen which is called natural lumen. But they who are in the externals, and at the same time in the internals of the Church, of worship, and of the Word, are in love towards the neighbour and in love to the Lord, and thence in the light of Heaven. Signified.
The state of the external when what is internal flowed in from the Lord. Signified, Described.
Communication with those who are in externals devoid of what is internal. Signified.
The Angels said, These are the externals (of worship) which ought to be done...
The cause of this blindness and ignorance is that the external things, which are worldly and corporeal, had occupied and filled their minds...
Not considering that the evil and the good lead a similar life in externals...
Evil spirits are distinguished from the good chiefly by this, that the evil attend eagerly to what is said about external things...
By this was represented those who in externals live alike sincerely and justly...
In proportion as man from internal becomes external, spiritual light is darkened with him...
When worldly, corporeal, and earthly things are loved more than spiritual, celestial, and Divine things, in the same proportion the man is external.
See Evil.
In external things man is led and taught by the Lord to all appearance as by himself. General article.
This is so done in man's externals, but not in internals...

These are the externals in which man is together with the Lord. And as externals make one with internals... no disposition can be made by the Lord in internals except in accordance with the disposition that is made in externals by means of the man. DP 181:2.
These things make the external of life even with the evil. Into this external of life every infant is born... but as the child grows... he comes from that external to more interior things.
At first they are kept by turns in externals...
They who are in the externals of the Church have not so confirmed falsities...
The influx of truth and good from the Lord with those who are in the Church of the Reformed who are in its externals... and are called laymen. Signified.
That in this New Church there will not be any external separated from what is internal... Signified.
The external from the internal, which the Angels called the external of the internal, is devoid of all lasciviousness. Explained.
(A devil wise when in externals.)
Many who in the world have lived in externals like others... yet the Angels charge these things upon some as evils of sin, and not upon others...

After death every man... is at first remitted into his externals, in which he was when in the former world, and he then believes that he is certainly going to Heaven, and he talks intelligently and acts prudently... SE 5688.
If the will refuses the truly rational things of the understanding... the man then becomes external; and therefore with those who only understand... the Lord's presence is universal or external...
When man indulges in external things, he is removed from the company of the Angels.
That those who have excelled in cleverness, but in externals only, in the other life are stupid.
On the reduction of external things into equilibrium by internal ones.
On those who are honest in externals...

Insanities, that is, phantasies, reign with all those who constitute the externals of man; for externals are of such a character that they act against internals, and yet they are kept in their connection and order by internals...
When external things are removed internal things appear... But still external things are not altogether rejected; but are so disposed by the Lord that they may be subservient to interior things...
That natures are induced through externals.
They are sometimes remitted into externals...
That in the other life externals are nought...
They who are elevated into the Second and into the Third Heaven have all these externals with them...
In the other life externals are by degrees put off...
When the external is taken away from an evil person...

In this they have an external, like all Spirits; but it is quiescent with them, and they do not know that they have it; it is quiescent in the same way as is the external of man while he sleeps. Still, this external is full of their internals...

The Angels who are in the Spiritual Heaven are not in internals, but in externals; this external is also tripartite, being internal, middle, and external. The external which approaches the sensuous external in the world is quiescent...
On those who are in a holy external.
After the life of the body no one receives external things, but interior and internal ones.
A holy external. Explained.
That the external without the internal is not to be worshipped. Signified.
The understanding of the Word perishes as the man of the Church... becomes external; and he... becomes external as he recedes from charity...
This external, which exists also with the impious and evil, is what is here meant by a cloud.
(Thus) whatever man does from the external alone is unclean.
This breaks forth when the externals are laid aside, as takes place after death.
There is no external which does not proceed and come forth from internals...
To stand afar off = to be in externals.
Fear is the principal cause of an evil man's coming from internals into externals. Explained. AE 1163, Signified.
Still, man is further reformed through external means when he had before been reformed through internal means. Explained.
As soon as the external of their mind is taken away, they think, speak, and act insanely... But... they are remitted by turns into their externals, and thereby into their civil and moral life...
Redemption. 3. 1. As evil increases in the Church, so the man of the Church becomes external.
Redemption. 3. 2. As the man of the Church becomes external, so he becomes double...
Rationality with satans exists only in externals.
